$comment: Line drawings for guides (site/public/assets/illustrations/<id>.svg, 240x180, black 4px stroke, one red accent). A guide gets its frontmatter `image` if it has one, else the first drawing (in this order, so list narrower ones first) whose `match` fits its setup-finder tags, else its category's drawing. New drawings are design work: add the SVG and an entry here.

panel-light.alt: Line drawing of a machine's control panel with one light lit up in red.
panel-light.caption: The light on your panel tells you which cycle it wants.

grind-dial.alt: Line drawing of a grind dial turned towards fine, with the pointer and the end of the scale in red, and two coffee beans.
grind-dial.caption: Setting 1 is not the end of the range: the inner burr moves it.

fast-sour-shot.alt: Line drawing of an espresso shot running fast in two thin red streams, with a stopwatch beside the cup.
fast-sour-shot.caption: A fast shot is an under-extracted shot, whatever it tastes like.

espresso-machine.alt: Line drawing of an espresso machine's group head and portafilter pouring a red shot into a cup.
espresso-machine.caption: Home espresso, one change at a time.

grinder.alt: Line drawing of a burr grinder with beans in the hopper, its dial pointer in red and grounds falling into a cup.
grinder.caption: The grinder decides more of the shot than the machine does.

tamper-and-scale.alt: Line drawing of a tamper next to a cup on a coffee scale with a red reading.
tamper-and-scale.caption: Small tools that make the shot repeatable.
